name: seis-ai-agent
description: Versioned unified SEIS-Agent: the default public SEIS entry point with bounded optional bundle guidance across governance, cloud, code, design, data, security, research, automation, and product lanes.

interface.shortDescription: Default public SEIS entry point with one-bundle-at-a-time guidance.
interface.longDescription: SEIS-Agent is the canonical public SEIS starting point. It coordinates SEIS, SEIS-Cloud, SEIS-Code, SEIS-Design, SEIS-Data, Security, Research, Automation, and Product lanes, and it helps users choose at most one optional bounded SEIS Repo bundle for a scoped task without bulk installation or external access.
capabilities: SEIS Security threat, secret, and release-risk review
SEIS Research evidence and source evaluation
SEIS Automation repeatable workflow and runbook design
SEIS Product roadmap, scope, and acceptance criteria
defaultPrompt: Show the six SEIS public starter paths and choose one optional bundle for this task.
Route this SEIS work across cloud, code, design, data, security, research, automation, and product.
Plan the next SEIS-Agent milestone without publishing or bulk-installing packages.
